summary_oneline: Add MetaClient for Meta Model API (Muse Spark) over both Chat Completions and Responses API; live-verified against the repo's own key

localization.role: shared funnel - already emits Meta-legal tool_choice/max_tokens
strict-schema normalizer - conformant with Meta's subset
parrot's client-side lazy-tool path overlapping Meta tool_search

claims.claim: Meta Model API is real, live, and returns OpenAI-shaped error envelopes
The documented auth env var is MODEL_API_KEY, not the META_API_KEY the brief requests
OpenAIBaseClient is a purpose-built extension point with a documented 7-step recipe
Search grounding, tool search, custom tools and token counting are Responses-API-only
OpenAIBaseClient has no Responses API support; _is_responses_model() is False in the base
parrot's existing tool_choice='auto' emission is already Meta-legal
ToolFormat.OPENAI's strict:true output conforms to Meta's strict subset
claims.reasoning: Upgraded from medium: live 200 with strict:true on a conformant schema.

claims.claim: muse-spark-1.3-contributor grants Meta permission to train on prompts and completions
Prompt caching requires zero implementation - it is automatic server-side
A Chat-Completions-only MetaClient is near-mechanical, ~200 lines, mirroring OpenRouterClient
logprobs returns HTTP 400 and reasoning_content is redacted to empty for external keys
An in-flight max_completion_tokens spec may interact with this work
claims.reasoning: The spec file is modified in the working tree by another session; its content was not read.

claims.claim: Muse Spark spends most of its output budget on reasoning tokens
The 7 model ids are live-verified ground truth
Responses output is typed items not choices; output_text is SDK-only
